{"action": "run_sql", "sql": "WITH RECURSIVE
-- explode order lines to sku quantities
lines AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, ol.qty AS line_qty, l.sku_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  JOIN order_line ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND s.store_name = 'Amazon-US-00'
    AND o.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
-- expand bundles into item skus
sku_qty AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_date, sku_id, line_qty AS qty FROM lines WHERE sku_id NOT IN (SELECT sku_id FROM sales_sku WHERE is_bundle)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.order_id, l.order_date, bi.item_sku_id, l.line_qty * bi.qty
  FROM lines l
  JOIN sales_sku ss ON ss.sku_id = l.sku_id AND ss.is_bundle
  JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = l.sku_id
),
-- map sku to models
model_qty AS (
  SELECT sq.order_id, sq.order_date, sm.model_id, sq.qty * sm.qty AS qty
  FROM sku_qty sq
  JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = sq.sku_id
),
-- explode model BOM to leaf parts, respecting validity on order date
bom_explode AS (
  SELECT mq.order_id, mq.order_date, mb.component_id, mq.qty * mb.qty AS qty
  FROM model_qty mq
  JOIN model_bom mb ON mb.model_id = mq.model_id
    AND mb.valid_from <= mq.order_date AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mq.order_date <= mb.valid_to)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT be.order_id, be.order_date, cb.child_component_id, be.qty * cb.qty
  FROM bom_explode be
  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = be.component_id AND c.is_assembly
  JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = be.component_id
    AND cb.valid_from <= be.order_date AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR be.order_date <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(be.qty) AS total_units
FROM bom_explode be
JOIN component c ON c.component_id = be.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FAS-695-GRY-02559' AND c.is_assembly = false;"}
